items.title: TikTok to pay Alabama at least $100M over teen safety
items.summary: Settlement resolves state claims the app was designed to addict children and adds new teen safety limits before trial.

items.title: EU member states begin examining the Kids Act
items.summary: Coreper opened talks on the Commission’s minors proposal; age checks and DSA alignment are early concerns ahead of November.

items.title: Canada’s Safe Social Media Act goes beyond an under-16 ban
items.summary: Bill C-34 pairs an age limit with platform duties on addictive design, AI companions, and privacy-preserving age checks.
